Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
   

  

 We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. title: Software Engineer – FrontEnd - Reuters
description:
Reuters is the world’s largest multimedia news provider, reaching billions of people every day and employing over 2,700 journalists in nearly 200 locations. Consumers, the media, and financial markets trust us to provide real\-time text, images, and video news across every content category.
   

  

 Reuters.com and related mobile apps are consumer\-facing product platforms that enable our target customers to access all the content they need from a single destination. We are investing in our next generation of Reuters.com to make content discovery faster and simpler, enhancing client curation, and allowing our targeted audience to find more relevant stories related to their interests more quickly than ever. We’re seeking colleagues who enjoy the agility, creativity, and entrepreneurial spirit required by our multimedia products. This role is based at our office in Bangalore, India, and you’ll work as part of a motivated team with friendly, skilled, and engaging colleagues.
   

  

 The Client Application Technology team is dedicated to creating compelling experiences that deliver Reuters' outstanding journalism to the world’s most informed professionals. The team aims to increase discovery, optimise conversion, and drive engagement across Thomson Reuters products and services. The technology focuses on web development and substantial backend service integration.
   

  

 You will work with a distributed team of software developers, quality engineers, and product managers focused on developing and integrating platforms and services that power Reuters experiences, including content creation, curation, publishing, distribution, and e\-commerce.
   

  

 As a technologist, you will develop business\-critical applications and services for the Reuters news organisation. We provide publishers and broadcasters with news text, graphics, photos, audio, and video over the Internet and via satellite, while also offering web\-scale hosted content solutions to digital publishers.
   

  

 Location: Bangalore, India, Hybrid
   

  

**About The Role**
* The Software Development Engineer will be responsible for developing code and proactively managing risks.
* We expect your work to demonstrate a strong technical background and a commitment to writing concise, scalable code.
* You will collaborate with fellow engineers to share knowledge, design, develop, test, and deploy software. Additionally, you will help coordinate with development partners to ensure features are released on time and within budget.
* You will modify existing software to fix errors or enhance performance when necessary.
* Demonstrate best\-in\-class software engineering skills to develop secure, tested, optimised, scalable code.
* Collaborate with designers, product managers, ops engineers, QA engineers, and other teams and stakeholders to solve innovative problems using out\-of\-the\-box solutions.
* Write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the software can understand.
* Identify and resolve the root cause of software defects.
* Identify and document product architecture and solution design
* Communicate clearly and effectively via GitHub, Slack, MS Teams, JIRA, etc., to keep all stakeholders in the loop on relevant issues.
* Interact thoughtfully and professionally with everyone, including non\-technical colleagues.
* Work with central technology teams to establish and adhere to best practices.
* Present practical input for strategic technology decisions.
* Comply with all professional departmental and company best practices.


**About You**
* 3\-5 years of professional experience in frontend engineering.
* Solid understanding of TypeScript, Node.js, and React
* Infrastructure knowledge for building low\-latency and scalable apps
* Professional communication skills \- English B2\+


**Nice To Have Skills/Experience**
* CLEAN Architecture
* Domain Driven Design
* Functional programming
* Microfrontends
* Monorepo Tooling
* Next.js (SSR/SSG)
* Automated cross\-browser testing
* Agile / Scrum process


**What’s in it For You?**
* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2\-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award\-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work\-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro\-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real\-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


**About Us**
 Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
   

  

 We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
   

  

 As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug\-free workplace.
   

  

 We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

* Build internal tools that enable support, manufacturing, and business teams to be successful.
* Collaborate with engineers across multiple domains — mobile, cloud, firmware, and QA — to complete full\-stack projects.
* Leverage the wealth of data the SPAN panel generates to create delightful, data\-rich user experiences.
* Integrate with external datasets and services while maintaining reliability and performance.
* Use test\-driven development and engineering best practices to ship with confidence.

* 2–6 years of experience in web software development, with meaningful experience building production applications in React.

* Strong skills in representing data through charts, graphs, and interactive visualizations.
* Proficiency working in a shared codebase using source control (Git), linting, code review, and CI/CD practices.
* Strong JavaScript experience and a willingness to work with (or learn) TypeScript.
* Familiarity with client–service communication patterns such as REST, gRPC, and real\-time messaging (e.g., MQTT, Ably, WebSockets).
* Experience working closely with design teams to build shared component libraries and maintain a cohesive design system.


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Experience with Internet of Things (IoT) products or systems with a hardware component (e.g., AWS IoT, embedded device communication).
* Familiarity with complex graphing and visualization libraries such as D3 or Recharts.
* Experience with on\-premise or locally\-hosted web applications, including offline\-first patterns.
* Close collaboration with a mobile engineering team.
* Familiarity with energy, cleantech, or utility industry domains.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

description:
Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever\-evolving healthcare industry.


We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?

 **Then come and join our global team as** **Data Engineer (f/m/d) Intellectual Property Systems****.**

 **Choose the best place for your work** – Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.

 **Even more flexibility?** Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.

  

This position is full\-time or part\-time with a minimum of 30h/week.

 **Your tasks and responsibilities:**

  

* You design and are responsible for a robust database infrastructure as the foundation for our IP reporting, working closely with our external provider of the IP management system.
* You develop and integrate AI based tools into all aspects of our IP processes (analysis, reporting, workflows, quality assurance).
* You create dashboards and automated reports on key performance indicators of our IP portfolio.
* You develop and maintain interfaces between IP specific applications and internal IT systems (SAP, HR).
* You develop and maintain connections to external databases, search and drafting tools, as well as to the electronic legal communication systems of patent and trademark offices (DPMAdirektPro, myEPO).
* You oversee compliance processes in the context of working with external IT service providers (cybersecurity, data privacy, works council).
* You support our IP experts in their daily work with our software landscape.

  

To find out more about the specific business, have a look at https://www.siemens\-healthineers.com/products\-services

 **Your qualifications and experience:**

  

* You completed a bachelor’s degree in computer science, business informatics, data science or a comparable field.
* You have initial experience in the field of intellectual property.
* You possess good knowledge of SQL and basic experience in data modeling as well as in data lake technologies (e.g., Microsoft Fabric or Snowflake).
* You have practical experience in data visualization (Power BI), in interacting with highly complex data sources and APIs, and with relevant programming languages (e.g., Python, C\#).
* You have basic knowledge in data privacy and cybersecurity.
* You can look back on experience working with international partners.

 **Your attributes and skills:**

  

* You communicate clearly, professionally and service oriented, even in complex situations.
* You have good German skills (B1\) and fluent English skills (C1\).
* You work independently, in a structured and solution oriented manner, and keep an overview even with many interfaces.
* You enjoy working in an international, intercultural environment and bring a high level of quality awareness.

 **Our global team:**


Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.

 **Our culture:**


Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That’s why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success. Check our Careers Site at https://www.siemens\-healthineers.com/de/careers


As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.\#myabilityshs


Wish to find out more before applying? Contact us: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens\-healthineers.com, if you wish to discuss any initial questions with our recruitment team. The contact person handling this job ad is Deniz Gürgen.


We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Click here to get started.

 **To all recruitment agencies:**


Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.

description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **practical, hands\-on HR Manager** who can **build, manage, and scale HR functions from the ground up** in a growing business environment.

This is a **high\-ownership role** covering **recruitment, HR operations, policies, compliance, employee engagement, and performance management**, with a strong focus on **execution, cost efficiency, and team productivity**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Hiring \& Talent Acquisition (Core Focus)**

* Manage end\-to\-end hiring for all roles (EA, operations, sales, support, creative, finance, MIS, etc.)
* Source candidates via job portals, references, consultants, and local hiring
* Screen, shortlist, coordinate interviews, and close positions quickly
* Ensure hiring aligns with **budget, role\-fit, and company culture**

**2\. HR Setup, Policies \& SOPs**

* Create and implement **basic HR policies, rules, and SOPs**
* Develop employee handbook (attendance, leave, discipline, code of conduct)
* Ensure clear communication and enforcement of policies

**3\. Employee Management \& Discipline**

* Maintain attendance, leaves, punctuality, and basic discipline
* Handle employee issues, warnings, and grievance resolution
* Ensure a **structured and professional work environment**

**4\. Performance Management \& Coaching**

* Set up simple **KRA/KPI systems for teams**
* Track performance and support managers in reviews
* Coach employees for improvement and productivity

**5\. HR Operations \& Documentation**

* Maintain employee records, contracts, and documentation
* Manage onboarding, confirmations, and exit processes
* Coordinate payroll inputs and compliance documentation

**6\. Compliance \& Basic Legal Adherence**

* Ensure adherence to **basic labour laws and statutory requirements**
* Maintain documentation for audits and inspections
* Coordinate with CA / legal consultants if required

**7\. Culture, Engagement \& Retention**

* Maintain a positive, disciplined, and performance\-driven culture
* Plan small engagement activities and team initiatives
* Focus on **retention of good performers**

**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**

**1\. Hiring Speed \& Quality**

* Close positions quickly with the right candidates

**Success Metrics**

* Time\-to\-hire (target: fast closures)
* Offer acceptance rate
* New hire retention (3 months)

**2\. Policy Implementation \& Discipline**

* Establish and enforce HR rules and structure

**Success Metrics**

* Reduction in late coming / absenteeism
* Policy compliance across teams
* Reduced escalations

**3\. Employee Performance \& Productivity**

* Improve output through basic performance systems

**Success Metrics**

* KPI/KRA implementation across teams
* Performance improvement cases
* Manager feedback

**4\. HR Operations Accuracy**

* Maintain clean, error\-free HR processes

**Success Metrics**

* Accurate employee records
* Payroll input accuracy
* Zero documentation gaps

**5\. Retention \& Work Environment**

* Reduce attrition and maintain team stability

**Success Metrics**

* Attrition rate ↓
* Retention of key employees
* Employee satisfaction (informal feedback)

**6\. Cost Efficiency**

* Manage hiring and HR costs effectively

**Success Metrics**

* Cost per hire
* Minimal dependency on expensive agencies
* Optimized HR processes

**Skills \& Competencies Required**

* Strong hands\-on experience in **recruitment and HR operations**
* Practical knowledge of **HR policies and labour law basics**
* Ability to handle **multiple roles and departments**
* Strong **discipline, control, and execution mindset**
* Good communication and conflict resolution skills
* Proficiency in **Excel, Google Sheets, and basic HRMS tools**

**Preferred Profile**

* Experience in **SME / startup / growing business**
* Comfortable with **both blue\-collar and white\-collar hiring**
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong ownership and problem\-solving attitude

title: HR Service Delivery Associate
description:
**Skill required:** Talent Acquisition \- Onboarding  

**Designation:** HR Service Delivery Associate  

**Qualifications:**Any Graduation
  

**Years of Experience:**1 to 3 years
  

**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** Day\-to\-day activity: Execute new\-hire onboarding (pre\-boarding to 30/60/90\), coordinate induction/training/buddy programs, ensure policy/verification compliance, and support placement management (deployment/redeployment, bench utilization, internal mobility) with accurate tracker hygiene. Key responsibilities: • Run pre\-boarding logistics, documentation, and Day\-1 readiness; deliver structured onboarding touchpoints. • Track new\-hire milestones (equipment, training completion, early productivity) and escalate risks. • Maintain placement pipeline and redeployment opportunities with hiring/ops; schedule interviews and update statuses. • Capture feedback to improve the onboarding experience. Work Model \& Shifts: WFO; US shift flexibility when needed for placements.  

**What are we looking for?** Education: Graduate Degree Total Years of Experience: 2–5 years of relevant industry experience Total Years of Role Specific Experience : 1–3 years in the specific function
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines • Your expected interactions are within your own team and direct supervisor • You will be provided detailed to moderate level of instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instruction on new assignments • The decisions that you make would impact your own work • You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team, with a predetermined, focused scope of work • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

description:
**About us**

HBOX is a US Based Venture backed Digital Health Company. We enable Health Care Providers (HCP) to capture true Virtual Care Opportunities beyond Telehealth. We enable HCP to provide Proactive and Continuous Care and add new Recurring monthly revenue streams without any upfront cost. We are a US\-focused Post revenue company with customers in 9 US States and growing fast. We provide an excellent opportunity to Innovate and work on cutting\-edge product technologies in a very fast\-moving dynamic and empowered environment.

**Job brief**

We are looking for a **Data Engineer** who is ready to bridge the gap between academic theory and production\-grade data pipelines. You don’t need a decade of experience; you need a rock\-solid grasp of **Python** and **SQL**, a passion for automation, and the curiosity to figure out why a pipeline broke.

In this role, you will be mentored by senior engineers to build the "pipes" that power our company’s decision\-making.

**Build Data Flows:** Write Python scripts to fetch, clean, and move data from various sources (Excels, APIs, CSVs, Databases) into our central warehouse.

**Data Hygiene:** Help maintain our data dictionary and documentation so everyone speaks the same "data language."

**Requirements**

**SQL Fundamentals:** You can comfortably use JOINs, GROUP BY, and CTEs. You understand the difference between a Primary Key and a Foreign Key.

**Python Proficiency:** You can write scripts to automate repetitive tasks. You’ve used libraries like pandas, json, or requests in your projects.

**Problem\-Solving Grit:** When code doesn't work, your first instinct is to dive into the logs, check Stack Overflow, and experiment until it clicks.

**The "Builder" Portfolio:** You have a GitHub or a project (school or personal) that demonstrates you can move data from Point A to Point B.

**Communication:** You can explain your technical logic clearly to both engineers and non\-technical teammates.

**STEM Educator** will play a pivotal role in supporting the operations and activities of CognoSpace at the school, a physical modern **educational space** where high school students engage in **hands\-on science experiments,** and technology\-based learning using **Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality** tools. title: QC Executive
description:
Job Title

**Quality Control Executive – Particle Board**

Department

Quality Control / Production

Reporting To

QC Manager / Plant Head

Job Purpose

To ensure particle boards are manufactured as per required quality standards, specifications, and statutory norms through systematic inspection, testing, and process control.

Key Responsibilities1\. Incoming Material Inspection

* Check quality of wood particles, resin, wax, and additives
* Verify moisture content and particle size
* Ensure raw materials meet approved standards

2\. In\-Process Quality Control

* Monitor mat formation, resin distribution, and layer consistency
* Check press parameters (temperature, pressure, press time)
* Ensure thickness and density control during production

3\. Finished Product Inspection

* Inspect boards for surface defects, edge cracks, blisters, and color variation
* Measure thickness, size, and density
* Ensure sanding quality and dimensional accuracy

4\. Laboratory Testing

* Conduct physical and mechanical tests:
* Internal Bond (IB)
* MOR \& MOE
* Screw holding strength
* Thickness swelling \& water absorption
* Maintain test records and reports

5\. Standards \& Compliance

* Ensure compliance with **IS 3087 / customer specifications**
* Monitor formaldehyde emission norms (E0/E1/E2 if applicable)

6\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain QC registers, inspection reports, and batch records
* Report deviations and non\-conformities to production team
* Support internal and external audits

7\. Corrective \& Preventive Actions

* Identify quality issues and root causes
* Coordinate with production for corrective actions
* Assist in continuous quality improvement

Qualification

* Diploma / B.Sc / B.Tech (Wood Technology / Mechanical / Production / relevant field)
* Experience in **particle board / plywood / MDF industry** preferred

Experience

* 1–5 years in QC role (freshers with relevant knowledge may apply)

Skills Required

* Knowledge of particle board manufacturing process
* Understanding of IS standards and QC testing methods
* Basic lab testing skills
* Documentation \& reporting
* Attention to detail

* Comfort in adopting and learning **new AI\-assisted workflows** for outreach and reporting.
* Resilient, self\-motivated, and target\-oriented mindset.

title: Content Creator & Agricultural Scholar | The Voice of Modern Agri-tech
description:
At **Waytoogreen**, we don't just need someone to write articles. We need a **Scholar\-Storyteller**—someone who can dive deep into agricultural science and translate it into a digital movement.

We are an early\-stage, mission\-driven platform bridging the gap between traditional agriculture and modern, climate\-smart practices. We are looking for an academic powerhouse who can simplify complexity and inspire a "green" revolution through content.

**Location:** Chennai

**Role:** Entry / Mid\-Level \| Subject Matter Expert \+ Creative Strategist

**Education:** B.Sc. / M.Sc. / M.Phil. / Ph.D. in Agriculture (Mandatory)

**CEO’S NOTE:**

This isn't a typical "social media manager" role. You will sit at the intersection of **Science** and **Communication**. You aren't just hitting "post"; you are building the educational authority of our brand from the ground up. If you want to move from the lab/field to a platform where your knowledge impacts thousands—read on.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN (THE MISSION):**

* **The Content Engine:** Take full accountability for our educational output. You will define the content mix for B2C (Student Certifications) and B2B (Institutional Knowledge Partners).
* **Bilingual Authority:** Create high\-impact content in both **Tamil** (for our rural and farmer\-centric roots) and **English** (for our corporate and global academic partners).
* **The Curriculum:** Collaborate with the product team to design modules for climate\-smart practices, ensuring every word is scientifically accurate yet easy to digest.
* **The Narrative:** Move beyond technical jargon. You will write scripts for videos, design infographics, and author whitepapers that showcase the future of sustainable farming.
* **Academic Liaison:** Act as the technical bridge between Waytoogreen and our university partners (like TNAU), ensuring our platform stays at the cutting edge of research.

**WHO YOU ARE (THE MUST\-HAVES):**

* **Academic Background:** A degree in Agriculture is non\-negotiable. You must know your soil, your crops, and your climate tech.
* **The "Translator" Skill:** You have a rare ability to take a 40\-page research paper and turn it into a 2\-minute video script or a 500\-word blog post.
* **Startup Mindset:** High agency, low ego. You are willing to research the data, write the copy, and help direct the video shoot.

**THE CEO’S WISHLIST (BONUS POINTS):**

* **Native\-level fluency in Tamil** (written and spoken) is a massive advantage.
* Experience in **Agri\-Extension** or **EdTech** content creation.
* A genuine obsession with **Sustainability** and the **Green Economy**.

**WHY JOIN WAYTOOGREEN?**

* **Impact:** Your words will directly contribute to farmer upskilling and the global fight against climate change.
* **Ownership:** You aren't just a writer; you are the "Chief Scholar" of our brand narrative.
* **Growth:** Competitive Salary a front\-row seat in an accelerating Agri\-tech start\-up.

**HOW TO APPLY:**

Don't just send a generic resume. Show us your work. Send us a writing sample or a link to a project where you made science look simple.

**Join us in building a greener future at Waytoogreen!**

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a skilled Website Developer responsible for designing, coding, and maintaining websites. The candidate should have a strong understanding of web technologies and be able to create responsive, user\-friendly websites.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain websites and web applications
* Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code
* Work on **front\-end (UI/UX)** and basic **back\-end development**
* Ensure websites are **responsive and mobile\-friendly**
* Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing websites
* Integrate third\-party tools, plugins, and APIs
* Optimize website performance and loading speed
* Ensure website security and data protection
* Coordinate with designers, content writers, and other team members
* Provide regular updates and reports to the management

**Skills \& Requirements:**

* Knowledge of **HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, C\+\+**
* Basic understanding of **PHP / WordPress / Shopify (if required)**
* Familiarity with frameworks like **React, Angular, or Bootstrap (optional)**
* Understanding of **SEO principles**
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Good communication skills
* Reel creater and Editor

**Experience:**

* Fresher or experienced candidates can apply
* Prior project/portfolio will be an advantage

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
**Graphic Designer \& Video Editor Intern**

**Location:** Kochi  
**Duration:** 3–6 Months  
**Start Date:** Immediate

**Role Overview**

We’re looking for a **Graphic Designer \& Video Editor Intern** who can create visually engaging content for digital platforms. This is not a “learn\-only” internship — you’ll be working on real brand assets, campaigns, and marketing creatives.

If you can’t meet deadlines or need constant hand\-holding, this role is not for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design creatives for:
* Social media (Instagram, LinkedIn, ads)
* Posters, banners, brochures
* Brand assets and marketing materials
* Edit videos for:
* Reels, short\-form content
* Promotional videos
* Ad creatives
* Collaborate with marketing \& content team to execute campaigns
* Maintain brand consistency (colors, fonts, style)
* Take feedback and iterate fast (no ego issues)

**Required Skills**

* Basic to intermediate knowledge of:
* Adobe Photoshop / Illustrator / Canva
* Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects (or similar tools)
* Understanding of:
* Social media trends (especially reels/short\-form content)
* Basic design principles (layout, typography, color)
* Ability to:
* Deliver on time
* Handle multiple tasks
* Work independently without constant supervision

**Good to Have (Not Mandatory)**

* Motion graphics experience
* Branding knowledge
* UI/UX basics
* Experience working on real client projects

Job Types: Fresher, Internship  
Contract length: 6 months

Pay: From ₹1,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
